· Position relative to SMA100 (116,059 KRW) / SMA200 (95,619 KRW): Mixed long-term trend with short-term strength.

· 5-day / 20-day High-Low Pattern: Forming a Higher Low pattern, indicating a recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.79x): Below previous average, indicating moderate confidence in the move.
· Current phase diagnosis: Short-term pullback within an uptrend; entry condition met upon confirmation of 110,485 KRW support.
